purpose: Add one pure-read Song Knowledge Map that projects canonical Song/version/asset/evidence/Activity/provenance relationships without creating a second graph store or leaking another Song.

lineage.outcome: The artist can inspect one coherent Song map and understand which versions, assets, evidence, Activity and provenance records belong together without state duplication or cross-Song leakage.
lineage.capability: Canonical read-only Song Knowledge Graph projection

legacy_candidates: ProjectGraph node-kind ideas as evidence only

completion_proof: Song map emits unique immutable typed nodes and deterministic typed edges from existing canonical owners only
CURRENT and APPROVED remain separate edges to their exact versions
version parentage, Song assets and version-asset membership are projected without cross-Song links
Song/version evidence claims include superseded history and explicit supersession edges
Song-scoped Activity is represented chronologically by sequence and linked to its canonical target
provenance records describe canonical outputs and DERIVED_FROM links point to same-Song canonical input or explicit EXTERNAL_REF
repeated map reads after restart insert/update/delete zero canonical rows and return an equal deterministic map
missing or inconsistent canonical targets fail visibly rather than being omitted or fabricated
non_scope: stored graph database or graph mutation API
Technical Twin / Creative Twin consumer UX
next_selection_rule: After CORE-01G proof, reconcile evidence and globally reselect. Do not expand the graph by adjacency.
